name: Atexxo Zone 1 iPhone 14
summary: The Atexxo Zone 1 iPhone 14 is a standard Apple iPhone 14 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It uses a flameproof (Ex db) housing. The phone runs iOS 27.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T4 Gb / Ex tb IIIC T135°C Db

safety.conditions: Flameproof Ex db enclosure (dust: Ex tb). Specific conditions (IECEx EPS 23.0033X): Ta −20 to +50 °C; no repair of flameproof joints; screws min. property class A4-70; original parts only; protect glass windows from impact > 2 J; do not open in hazardous location; battery charging only outside hazardous location.

specs.display: 6.1-inch OLED Super Retina XDR; Ceramic Shield
specs.batteryLife: Up to 20 hours of video playback
specs.nfc: Yes (Apple Pay + Core NFC tag reading)
specs.keys: Side, volume, Ring/Silent switch (no Action Button)
specs.satellite: Emergency SOS + Roadside Assistance via satellite (region-dependent)

throughCase.label: USB-C / Lightning port
throughCase.value: Wired charging in safe area (access method not stated)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (QR via Camera) / Via app (1D/2D)

capabilities.label: Satellite SOS
capabilities.value: Built in on iPhone; not verified through enclosure

unconfirmed.specs.ram: Apple doesn't publish RAM. This is the widely reported figure.
unconfirmed.specs.battery: Apple doesn't publish battery capacity. Figure from regulatory filings and teardowns.
unconfirmed.specs.satellite: Listed on Apple's tech specs; availability depends on the country.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
A standard Apple iPhone 14 inside, with the same apps and Apple device management as other iPhones
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Satellite SOS not confirmed to work through the enclosure
